summary: Added create-view and drop-view permission actions. In default_actions.py registered Action(name="create-view", resource_class=DatabaseResource) after create-table and Action(name="drop-view", resource_class=TableResource) after drop-table. In write_sql.py's decision_for_write_sql_operation added two cases before the alter/table case: create+view returns UnsupportedWriteSqlOperation if no database else RequireWriteSqlPermissions with create-view on the database; drop+view (with database and table) returns RequireWriteSqlPermissions with drop-view on TableResource. In sql_analysis.py renamed dropped_tables to dropped_tables_and_views and broadened the filter to target_type in {"table","view"} so the spurious delete on a dropped view doesn't become a delete-row requirement. Documented both actions in docs/authentication.rst: added them to the --root list and added action sections. tests/test_queries.py: 90 passed.
